chunks: And from him, from Abdullah ibn Jabala, from Ali ibn Abu Hamza, from Abu Baseer, similar to it.

And by this chain, from Yaqoub ibn Salim, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), regarding the man when he gives a choice to his wife, he said: 'Rather, the choice is for us, not for anyone else, and rather the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) gave a choice to Ayesha due to her status, so she chose Allah and His Messenger, and it was not for her to choose other than the Messenger of Allah and His Messenger.'
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling of Takhayyur (choice in divorce) and how did Ayesha exercise it?
ai.summary: This narration from al-Kafi clarifies the theological nuance of 'Takhayyur' (the choice) in divorce, asserting that the husband's grant of choice is ultimately subordinate to divine will and the Imam's authority rather than mere personal preference. It contextualizes the famous incident of Aisha, where the Prophet granted her the choice not to select a worldly alternative, but to affirm her bond with Allah and His Messenger, thereby establishing a model for spiritual fidelity in marital dissolution. This highlights the Shia scholarly view that the 'choice' is a mechanism for aligning human decision with divine decree.

en.hubeali: And from him, from Abdullah Bin Jabala, from Ali Bin Abu Hamza, from Abu Baseer – similar to it.

And by this chain, from Yaqoub Bin Salim, from Muhammad Bin Muslim, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> regarding the man when he gives a choise to his wife. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘But rather, the choice is for us<sup>asws</sup> and not for anyone (else), and rather Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> gave a choice to Ayesha at her place, so she chose Allah<sup>azwj</sup> and His<sup>azwj</sup> Rasool<sup>saww</sup>, and it was not for her that she chooses other than Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup>’.
en.sarwar: Through the same chain of narrators as that of the previous Hadith the following is narrated from Ya’qub ibn Salim from Muhammad ibn Muslim who has said the following: “About the case of a man who gives his wife the choice abu ‘Abd Allah, Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘The choice is only for us and not for anyone else. The Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, gave the choice because of the words of ‘A’ishah. They then chose Allah and His Messenger and they must not have chosen anyone other than the Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause.’”
